title: QAReportHandoff
description: Output of the QA Agent evaluating final video quality, synchronization, and attribution.

passed.description: True if all QA checks pass and video is ready for publishing

name.description: Name of verification check (e.g., duration_sync, loudness, attribution_present, no_black_frames)

detail.description: Diagnostic details, measurements, or error information

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings detected during QA checks

redo_stage.description: The specific pipeline stage ID to re-run on failure, or null if passed
